tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out this subchapter.

tree.heading: Limitation on expenditures for administrative expenses
tree.text: Funds appropriated to carry out this subchapter may not be expended for the payment of expenses incurred by a board to administer an order.
